description: Writes a draft accessibility statement for a web shop or online store under the European Accessibility Act (EAA, Annex V; in Germany the BFSG, where it is often called Barrierefreiheitserklärung), in Markdown: service description, how it works, measures, status, known issues, feedback contact, and the market surveillance authorities on file for the selected EU countries (a visible placeholder where none is verified). Uses only the answers given; nothing is stored. It does not test or scan a website.

feedback_url.description: Contact form URL for accessibility feedback

known_issues.description: Known accessibility problems, with WCAG success criteria, impact and planned fix date

manual_checks.description: Manual accessibility checks done, with dates (keyboard only, visible focus, zoom and reflow, text alternatives, video captions, form errors, consistent navigation, no time limits)

markets.description: EU countries where the store sells; used to list the market surveillance authorities on file

measures.description: Annex V (c): measures taken to meet the accessibility requirements

service_description.description: Annex V (a): general description of the online store

service_operation.description: Annex V (b): how the service works, as needed to understand it

status.description: How far the store meets the accessibility requirements so far

store_name.description: Name of the web shop or online store

name: accessibility_statement_draft
title: Draft an accessibility statement
